desc: This Steel Range Kit Includes Your Target, Stand And Gong Holder; Just Add Your Own 2X4 Wood Post. The 2-In-1 Gong Target Holder Allows You To Hang The 8 Inch Ar500 Steel Gong Easily At The Distance You Want. The 2X4 Steel Target Stand Is Sturdy And Holds The Post In Place Perfectly Down Range.
